title: Universal local rank matching of ordinary direct images
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $E$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $g:T\to S$. Write $p_k:X\times_S T'\to T'$ and $q_k:X\times_S T'\to X$ for the projections for any $k:T'\to S$. Use tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], ordinary pushforward [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and the dual $E^\vee=\mathcal Hom(E,\mathcal O_X)$. The predicate $R(f,E,g)$ holds if for every $h:T'\to T$ and point $t\in T'$ there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $t$ and an integer $r\geq0$ such that $p_{hg,*}q_{hg}^*E|_U$, $p_{hg,*}q_{hg}^*(E^\vee)|_U$, and $q_{U\to T'\to T\to S}^*E$ all are finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. There is no assertion about canonical base-change maps.
